```{r csv paths}

mds_csv_path      <- "~/Downloads/data_demo_mds (1).csv"

tts_positive_path <- "~/Downloads/positive_tts.csv"
tts_negative_path <- "~/Downloads/negative_tts.csv"

parquet_pos_path  <- "~/Downloads/positive.parquet"
parquet_neg_path  <- "~/Downloads/negative.parquet"


```


```{r 10% sample}

ds <- read_csv_arrow(mds_csv_path)

# get row count (streaming, safe)
n <- ds %>% summarise(n = n()) %>% collect() %>% pull(n)

sample_10 <- ds %>%
  head(floor(0.1 * n)) %>%
  collect()
```

```{r check}

colnames(sample_10)

``` 

```{r collect}
sample_10 <- sample_10 %>%
  group_by(recordId) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    recordId, age, gender, healthCode, recordId_mds,
    `MDS-UPDRS1.1`, `MDS-UPDRS1.3`, `MDS-UPDRS1.4`,
    `MDS-UPDRS1.5`, `MDS-UPDRS1.7`, `MDS-UPDRS1.8`,
    `MDS-UPDRS2.1`, `MDS-UPDRS2.4`, `MDS-UPDRS2.5`,
    `MDS-UPDRS2.6`, `MDS-UPDRS2.7`, `MDS-UPDRS2.8`,
    `MDS-UPDRS2.9`, `MDS-UPDRS2.10`, `MDS-UPDRS2.12`,
    `MDS-UPDRS2.13`
  ) %>%
  collect()
```

```{r severity score calculation}

sample_10 <- sample_10 %>%
  mutate(
    MDS_UPDRS1_total = rowSums(
      across(starts_with("MDS-UPDRS1")),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    MDS_UPDRS2_total = rowSums(
      across(starts_with("MDS-UPDRS2")),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  
  )
```

```{r clean}

sample_10 <- sample_10%>%
  select( recordId, age, gender, healthCode, recordId_mds, MDS_UPDRS1_total, MDS_UPDRS2_total)
          
          
```



```{r read csv}

tts_pos <- read.csv(tts_positive_path)
tts_neg <- read.csv(tts_negative_path)
```

```{r read parquet}

pos <- read_parquet(parquet_pos_path)
neg <- read_parquet(parquet_neg_path)
```

```{r add label}

tts_pos <- tts_pos %>% mutate(diagnosis = "positive")
tts_neg <- tts_neg %>% mutate(diagnosis = "negative")

pos <- pos %>% mutate(diagnosis = "positive")
neg <- neg %>% mutate(diagnosis = "negative")

```

```{r combine}

tts_all <- bind_rows(tts_pos, tts_neg)
acoustic_all <- bind_rows(pos, neg)

```

```{r sum}

tts_summary <- tts_all %>%
  group_by(healthCode) %>%
  summarise(
    time_to_stabilization_s =
      mean(time_to_stabilization_s, na.rm = TRUE),
    diagnosis = first(diagnosis),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r collapse}
mds_summary <- sample_10 %>%
  group_by(healthCode) %>%
  summarise(
    age = first(age),
    gender = first(gender),
    MDS_UPDRS1_total = mean(MDS_UPDRS1_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    MDS_UPDRS2_total = mean(MDS_UPDRS2_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_mds_visits = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r merge}

df <- acoustic_all %>%
  left_join(tts_summary, by = "healthCode") %>%
  left_join(mds_summary, by = "healthCode")

```

```{r average}

acoustic_summary <- acoustic_all %>%
  group_by(healthCode) %>%
  summarise(
    F0_mean = mean(F0, na.rm = TRUE),
    F1_mean = mean(F1, na.rm = TRUE),
    F2_mean = mean(F2, na.rm = TRUE),
    F3_mean = mean(F3, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r z-score calculation}

acoustic_deltaF <- acoustic_summary %>%
  mutate(
    dF1 = log(F1_mean) - log(F0_mean),
    dF2 = log(F2_mean) - log(F0_mean),
    dF3 = log(F3_mean) - log(F0_mean)
  )

```

```{r remerge}

df <- df %>%
  left_join(
    acoustic_deltaF %>%
      select(healthCode, gender, dF1, dF2, dF3),
    by = "healthCode"
  )

```

```{r df check}
colnames(df)

```
```{r install}

library("dplyr")
library("tidyr")
library("ggplot2")

```

```{r plot df prep}


plot_df <- acoustic_deltaF %>%
  left_join(
    df %>%
      select(healthCode, MDS_UPDRS2_total),
    by = "healthCode"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gender), !is.na(age), !is.na(MDS_UPDRS2_total))

```


```{r frequency fomratting}

plot_long <- plot_df %>%
 select(healthCode, gender, age, MDS_UPDRS2_total,
       dF1, dF2, dF3) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("d"),
    names_to = "formant",
    values_to = "z_value"
  )

```

```{r severity define}


plot_long <- plot_long %>%
  mutate(
    severity_group = cut(
      MDS_UPDRS2_total,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 10, 20, 30, Inf),
      labels = c("mild", "moderate", "moderate-severe", "severe")
    )
  )

```

```{r density plot}


ggplot(plot_long,
       aes(x = z_value,
           fill = gender,
           colour = gender)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.25) +
  facet_grid(formant ~ severity_group) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Z-scored formant value",
    y = "Density",
    title = "Distribution of F0–F3 by Gender and Severity"
  )

```

```{r violin plot}

ggplot(plot_long,
       aes(x = severity_group,
           y = z_value,
           fill = gender)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ formant, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Severity group",
    y = "Z-score",
    title = "Formant distributions by Gender and Disease Severity"
  )

```

```{r reload}
install.packages(c(

```

```{r load}

library(rlang)
library(tidyselect)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(vctrs)


```

```{r continuous plot}

ggplot(plot_long,
       aes(x = MDS_UPDRS2_total,
           y = z_value,
           colour = gender)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ formant, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal()
  
```


#add age as a factor in continous plot
```{r age groupings}

plot_long <- plot_long %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = cut(
      age,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, Inf),
      labels = c("<40", "40–49", "50–59", "60–69", "70–79", "80+")
    )
  )

```

```{r plot with age}

ggplot(plot_long,
       aes(x = MDS_UPDRS2_total,
           y = z_value,
           colour = gender)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(formant ~ age_group) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "MDS-UPDRS2 severity",
    y = "Normalized formant value",
    title = "Formant change with severity by age group"
  )

```
